objective: Decide, in one bounded pass, which publicly recorded strategy families still clear the frozen recent-window gates after our costs, fills and placebos, instead of inventing new rules.

sources.core_claim: Composer's TQQQ RSI Strategy page states the full rule in plain English -- a 200-day trend filter, RSI and PPO speed checks, TQQQ bought on dips and SHV held otherwise, with SQQQ or UVXY after extreme up days and TECL on deep sell-offs -- and reports a 68.9% annualized return with Sharpe 1.46 over the whole 2011-10-04 backtest, against roughly 41% annualized out of sample.
